nodes.label: S3 Router
nodes.desc: registerAPIRouter wires every S3 REST verb through s3APIMiddleware; objectAPIHandlers struct is defined here.

nodes.label: Object Handlers
nodes.desc: HTTP layer for GetObject (L717), HeadObject (L1012), CopyObject (L1157), PutObject (L1793), DeleteObject (L2563).

nodes.label: ObjectLayer Interface
nodes.desc: The ObjectLayer interface (L246) every backend implements: buckets, objects, versions, healing, pool info.

nodes.label: Server Bootstrap
nodes.desc: serverMain (L746) parses endpoints and calls newObjectLayer (L1199) to build the backend, then serves the API.

nodes.label: Server Pools
nodes.desc: erasureServerPools (L52) federates multiple pool of sets; newErasureServerPools (L78) is the ObjectLayer factory.

nodes.label: Erasure Sets
nodes.desc: erasureSets (L51) maps objects to a set of disks by hash; newErasureSets (L352) builds sets and their lockers.

nodes.label: Erasure Object Ops
nodes.desc: GetObjectNInfo (L203), PutObject (L1249), DeleteObject (L1885) fan out reads and writes across the set.

nodes.label: Reed-Solomon Codec
nodes.desc: Erasure struct (L35) and NewErasure (L42) wrap klauspost/reedsolomon with data and parity shard counts.

nodes.label: Erasure Metadata
nodes.desc: FileInfo quorum logic: shard placement via hashOrder (erasure-metadata-utils.go L178), part offsets, modtime quorum.

nodes.label: XL Storage
nodes.desc: Per-disk backend xlStorage (L98): ReadAll (L1829), CreateFile (L2092), WriteAll (L2305), RenameFile (L2997).

nodes.label: xl.meta Format
nodes.desc: xlMetaV2 (L901) is the on-disk metadata blob: object versions, parts, checksums, inline data.

nodes.label: Namespace Locks
nodes.desc: nsLockMap (L85) serializes bucket/object operations locally before they reach the distributed lock quorum.
